heading: Observation-channel counterexamples, model binding, and validator cut — no publication
subject: Boss Fight observation-channel, composition, path-selection, and proof-carrying budget claims
decision: Demote the four affected Boss Fight papers to Hold; replace scalar observation-rate claims with source-bound channel-witness requirements; repair active propagation consumers; preserve publication closed
reason: Scalar observation rates, equal contact marginals, marginal tier budgets, and retrospective leakage totals do not by themselves establish the joint channel, independent thinning, compositional independence, or prospective no-overshoot behavior required by the former claims
follow_up_needed: Obtain an external hostile-review countersignature and a source-bound observer-channel witness before any affected paper can leave Hold
summary: Rev0900 (`Anonymity-rev0900-2026.06.18.11.54-obschannel-counterexamples-modelbinding-validatorcut.zip`) repairs a release-adjacent inference that treated a scalar observation probability as an independent erasure channel. Equal per-secret reveal rates do not determine the conditional output law: an explicit three-secret cyclic-reveal mechanism has reveal probability one half for every secret, yet leaks one full bit and permits exact recovery with probability two thirds. The scalar-erasure calculation reports only 0.321928094887 bits and exact recovery 5/12, so it is not a certificate for that mechanism.
